title: The scalar localization unit telescope
statement: For an integral derived coefficient object K, define the diagram K --ℓ--> K --ℓ--> ⋯ and its cocone with vertex restriction of derived scalar extension of K. Its nth leg is the extension unit followed by restriction of the nth power of the inverse of multiplication by ℓ. Also define the same diagram and cocone after reindexing by ULift ℕ, and the identity-component comparison under any additive functor. Definitions and notation: [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients].

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), referring to Bhatt–Scholze Lemma 6.8.2; scalar localization telescope

proof.text: Multiplication by ℓ is invertible on the extended object. Centrality of scalar multiplication, additivity of restriction, and cancellation of ℓ against its inverse verify adjacent cocone compatibility. Identity components and additivity give the comparison of sequences under an additive functor. Reindex by the order equivalence ULift ℕ ≃ ℕ. Scalar invertibility reuses the existing module_nsmul_isIso or derived_nsmul_isIso theorem from ContinuousConstructibleIntegralImage, made public without changing its type or proof.
